turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no way to split average order value into first-time buyers' orders and returning customers' orders, so I can't give that difference. The closest metrics are average order value (EUR) (all non-cancelled orders, not split by buyer type), repeat customers, revenue from repeat customers (EUR) and repeat-customer revenue share, which cover repeat customers but not a per-order first-time versus returning average.
